b4732e19|6.0.q: presented the Artemis II crew members with the Congressional Space Medal of Honor — 훈장을 준 쪽과 받은 쪽은 각각 누구입니까?

b4732e19|7.0.q: that demonstrates his commitment 는 무엇을 설명하는 말입니까?
